title: Laser Zap
blurb: Descending pitch bend, a bit of noise on the tail, and you are instantly in a cabinet in 1981. Golden-age arcade shooters had barely any audio hardware, so their weapons were built from swept oscillators — which is why every laser in games sounded broadly the same and why the shape is still instantly legible today. Great for edits needing a pew, for scene transitions, or for dramatically pointing at somebody while maintaining eye contact. Synthesised from scratch in the classic style, so it is clean original audio and free to use anywhere.
origin: Original synthesis in the style of golden-age arcade shooters.
